The main takeaway from our work is that
the impact of PAHS contamination on plants and PAH dissimulation is dependent on the plant species and PAHs present in the soils.

phytoremediators may not be suitable for all sites, especially if the PAH concentration in the site is high and/or the PAH contamination is a mixture of PAHS with different chemical and physical properties.
